findings.summary: Rejected candidate 9272617d51e6f2f4a663249e2d3b624871c204ac could execute retirement before independent review and merge. The accepted candidate requires an exact independent-pass receipt and evidence on fetched main, candidate/main/cleanup equality for every reviewed lifecycle surface, candidate ancestry in the exact cleanup branch, and equality between the executing lifecycle script blob and the reviewed main blob. Pre-review and unmerged-script refusal tests pass.

Rejected candidate 9272617d51e6f2f4a663249e2d3b624871c204ac cleared a present-side recovery journal after checking only filesystem and Git-list presence. The accepted candidate re-proves canonical managed and reparse-safe path, repository identity, target branch, live/local/expected HEAD, pristine tracked/untracked/ignored state, and absence of nested worktrees before clearing. Detached, switched, moved-HEAD, residue, reparse, nested, and replaced-path tests preserve the exact journal and refuse.

Rejected candidate 9272617d51e6f2f4a663249e2d3b624871c204ac did not bind registry_previous_head to the pending before-record. The accepted candidate requires exact equality with before_record.head and additionally binds package, source task, branch, and path; malformed journal recovery refuses without mutation.

After merged PR 920, read-only production-state proof found that the released same-package control_singleton was counted alongside the durable cleanup worktree. Exact correction d74a7072efe5777d431f15a5906ac447fa18c808 scopes initial identity candidates to state=active and kind=durable before matching package, branch, or path. Multiple matching active durable records still refuse, and the independent all-record exact-path check still rejects path ambiguity across every kind and state. The fixture now creates and releases an active same-package control_singleton with a null lease alongside the active durable cleanup record; all closed-custody happy, authority, residue, recovery, and journal-poison tests exercise that production-shaped state. Seven focused tests and all 62 lifecycle tests passed, with all previously accepted receipt/blob, recovery, HEAD-binding, residue, race, and ref-preservation gates intact.

Independent review accepted final exact candidate d74a7072efe5777d431f15a5906ac447fa18c808 against current main ce4e026f2f6af30c98525fcc8efbb8a762361899 with no remaining blocking findings. The complete delta is limited to the durable-record selector and its production-shaped fixture. The command preserves original task_ref and all branches, tags, and refs, and uses only the shared ordinary non-force Git worktree removal helper.
